slug: the_interviews
title: The Interviews
blurb: Non-canon. Emmett and Josephine, perhaps the last two Squoatlings, are hounded across Daerthlorn by news crews whose questions get more personal every time.
authors: Zander
season: FF2
format: prose
---

It took Daerthlorn five months until the news crews realized who their newest residents were. Oh, the publicity their channels could receive with the event of a Squoatling couple living on their planet. Some time passed for the Channel Five crew to find the man, but as soon as they caught track of Emmett's whereabouts, it wasn't long until they found him.

"[Oh hi! You're a Squoatling!]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett looked from side to side while in his Vegetation Co. uniform.

"[Uhm, yes. I'm a Squoatling. What's it to you?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The spokesperson of the crew did a little jig out of excitement.

"[We were just curious if you would answer a few questions for Channel Five!]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett put a hoof to his chin, thinking for a bit.

"[I would like to, but I'd have to decline due to personal reasons.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett could not give his position away to the media, especially if it could be reached by Llamanians.

"[Oh! But we insist! You must!]{Channel Five Anchor}"

"[What?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett raised an eyebrow.

"[So, what brings you to our planet?]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett did not speak until he knew their efforts were persistent.

"[The two of us escaped from the Llamanians like a few months ago. We landed here and have lived here ever since.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Oh! So you aren't that new around here.]{Channel Five Anchor}"

"[I know where I am, I suppose.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[What do you plan on doing here?]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett shook his head.

"[I don't think you need to know that.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[But we do! We need to accommodate you in our home.]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett sighed loudly.

"[I guess we're just wanting to get by. Get our daily source of grass and possibly start a family.]{Emmett Tawfeek}" The anchor licked her lips due to how juicy she thought the information was.

"[So you admit you two are a couple?]{Channel Five Anchor}" Emmett gasped.

"[I never said that!]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Families need to have loving parents, Squoatling.]{Channel Five Anchor}" After this last statement, the lunch whistle blew.

"[Well, time for me to get back to work.]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[We'll be back!]{Channel Five Anchor}"

After Channel Five broadcasted the short interview, the other crews were infuriated. More and more interviews were made, with some lasting all night. Both Emmett and Josephine were exhausted. They went into positions where they knew they would not be interviewed. On the contrary, the crews caught up, and started to break barriers to reach them. Channel Six, in particular, actually broke into their apartment.

"[Josephine! We have some questions!]{Channel Six Guard}" A buff security guard kicked down the bathroom door. Josephine, who had just finished showering, pulled the shower curtain over herself to cover her shame.

"[What the hell, guys?!]{Josephine}"

"[Hey Josephine. We just--]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[Wanted to ask a few questions? Sure, I'm definitely in an available condition to direct my attention to you]{Josephine}," Josephine stammered. She was a little pissed that they would screw over their house for their avarice.

"[Remember Josephine, 4th law. States that news channels can invade privacy.]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[The laws here are stupid]{Josephine}," she muttered to herself.

"[First question, so, are you and Emmett a couple?]{Channel Six Anchor}" Josephine rolled her eyes to the side, a bit out of embarrassment.

"[Why is this important?]{Josephine}"

"[Just answer the question.]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[...Yes, we're mates, I guess. Still, why?]{Josephine}"

"[Wait, you two have--]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[No, no!]{Josephine}" the purple Squoatling cried.

"[We haven't thought about having a child. Not yet.]{Josephine}" The spokesman raised an eyebrow.

"[Not yet?]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[I mean, we're probably the last two of our kind. Praise Squoat that we're different genders. But I don't really want to mate with him yet.]{Josephine}"

"[Aren't you just being selfish then?]{Channel Six Anchor}" Josephine shuffled her hooves in the shower, furrowing her brow. She ended up slipping on the soapy floor beneath her.

"[I'm okay, I'm okay. Don't touch me!]{Josephine}" She got up and reluctantly got out, getting a towel to wrap herself up in.

"[Impressive figure, Ms. Josephine.]{Channel Six Anchor}"

"[Not a word about this, Channel Six.]{Josephine}" She made her way to the kitchen, inevitably being asked more highly personal questions.

"[So, Ms. Josephine, have you and Emmett...]{Channel Six Anchor}" The news anchor suggestively pushed one of his tentacle appendages through the other, which was wrapped in a circle.

"[If I say yes, will you leave me alone?]{Josephine}"

"[Ooh! Juicy!]{Channel Six Anchor}" He licked his lips.

"[Such a pervert...]{Josephine}"

"[Just a few more questions, madam. Mind having a drink with me?]{Channel Six Anchor}" Josephine smirked a little through her irritation.

Channel Eleven was the last of the news crews to forcibly interview the two Squoatlings. This crew caught the two off guard when they decided to have some lunch at a local coffee shop. Immediately, their emotions went south.

"[Yes, Channel Eleven?]{Emmett Tawfeek}" Emmett exhaled.

"[Just a few questions.]{Channel Eleven Reporter}"

"[Shoot]{Josephine}," Josephine quickly mouthed.

"[Do you two have a healthy relationship?]{Channel Eleven Reporter}" Refusing to speak any unnecessary information, Emmett tiredly nodded.

"[Josephine, has Emmett been treating you right?]{Channel Eleven Reporter}" Josephine smiled a little.

"[I mean, yeah. He's kind-of the reason why we're here. Definitely a treat in the sheets.]{Josephine}" Emmett nudged her in the side softly. "[What? It's true.]{Josephine}"

"[Now they're going to ask even m--]{Emmett Tawfeek}"

"[Who's the more dominant one out of you two?]{Channel Eleven Reporter}" Both of them kept quiet. They looked at one another, with Emmett shaking his head towards their interviewer.

"[If we answer this, will you guys stop?]{Josephine}"

"[We feel like we've gotten enough from the other times, so yes. Sure.]{Channel Eleven Reporter}" Josephine sat up straight in her seat.

"[I'm the fucker and he's the fuckee.]{Josephine}" She purposely said this in a way so that they could not use this information on television.

"[Is this true, Tawfeek?]{Channel Eleven Reporter}" Emmett just shrugged, chuckling at her crude response.
